name: Josselin Feist
description: Josselin Feist is a security researcher at Aave, where he leads the onchain risk effort. Previously, he was Engineering Director of the Blockchain team at Trail of Bits. He is the creator of Slither, the widely used Solidity static analysis framework, and holds a PhD in software vulnerability analysis. His work spans smart contracts, L1/L2 protocols, bridges, and core blockchain infrastructure, with a focus on systemic risks, protocol design, and security strategy.
